scope: Exact rerendered reference film, full narration and sampled encoded visual review. Every reported collision judged; human sound and native Apple playback remain separate.

lessons.independentOfAuthor: Existing handcrafted reference film; no film or narration edits by this reviewer.
lessons.reason: A complete connected construction links token states, learned projections, geometric scores, competing shares and a weighted output. Its later masking, scaling, gradients, cache and tiled-softmax explanations reuse that mechanism and earn the fresh-input ending. All18 authored encoded scene sheets, brand sheet and5 registered native frames personally inspected. All36 collision episodes judged against encoded captures with the4second brand offset, including7 full-resolution critical captures. The brief opaque-card transfer occlusions and dense later diagnostics account for deductions. This is an earned sampled visual/editorial recommendation, not an audible or human-playback certification.

inspectedTransformations.mechanism: Weighted values retain their token identity, scale and add tip to tail into the computed mixture; a dropout counterexample changes the constraint.
Successive tiles raise the maximum, rescale both retained sums, add current terms and divide to recover the same exact row output.
A new query earns a prediction before changed shares move the mixture endpoint while original keys and values remain fixed.

deductions: Rapid opaque-card transfers briefly cover neighboring labels; clear pre/post states preserve the explanation but moving states are less inspectable.
The later diagnostic overview is denser than the central geometric construction.
Audible performance, continuous human viewing and native Apple decode remain unverified.

encodedDecode.interpretation: Complete decode coverage and blank-content detection. Unexplained blank frames fail. Temporal peaks and long holds are review candidates; reading and prediction pauses can be intentional. Layout, teaching quality and aesthetics require the registered geometry audit and visual review.

visibleLabelInventory.findings: No material stale state or arithmetic error found in the listed labels. Source and encoded construction review distinguish numeric readout motion, short replacement crossfades, exact quantities and rounded teaching labels.
visibleLabelInventory.limits: Glyph parent source inventory checks listed values and intervals. It does not establish legibility, occlusion, audible synchronization or capture externally rasterized labels.
